title: A New Bridge for the City
text:
Yesterday, a local news report said that a new bridge will open in our city next month. The bridge will connect the north side of the river with the center of town. The mayor said the bridge will help many people go to work faster. Workers finished the bridge after two years.

The news report also said that the bridge has a special lane for bicycles. There will be a small park near the bridge. Many people are happy about the news. The bridge will open on the first Monday of next month.

questions.text: What will the new bridge connect, according to the news report?
options: The north side of the river and the center of town
The airport and the train station
Two schools in the south of the city
A large farm and a lake

questions.text: What special feature does the bridge have, according to paragraph two?
options: It has a hotel on top
It has a special lane for bicycles

questions.text: Why do many people probably feel happy about the new bridge?
options: Because the river will become smaller
Because the bridge will help them travel more easily
Because the workers will leave the town
Because the bridge is very old

questions.text: What can we infer about the city's plans for the area near the bridge?
options: They do not want people to use bicycles
They want to close the park
They plan to build a factory there
They want people to spend time outside and relax there

vocabulary.definition: a structure built over a river or road so people can cross
a separate part of a road for one kind of traffic

paragraph_translations: Ayer, un informe de noticias local dijo que un nuevo puente se abrirá en nuestra ciudad el próximo mes. El puente conectará el lado norte del río con el centro de la ciudad. El alcalde dijo que el puente ayudará a muchas personas a ir al trabajo más rápido. Los trabajadores terminaron el puente después de dos años.

El informe de noticias también dijo que el puente tiene un carril especial para bicicletas. Habrá un pequeño parque cerca del puente. Muchas personas están contentas con la noticia. El puente se abrirá el primer lunes del próximo mes.
